in_hebrew.name: Freida
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Freida הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Frid, meaning 'peace'. The name Freida has been popular in Europe for centuries and is known for its feminine and gentle nature.
